summary: RptMnuReport_Wizards is an ASP.NET UserControl designed to display and manage Wizard-based reports through a GridView. It connects to an ObjectDataSource, filters data based on user session and actor roles, and provides navigation to the ReportWizardMenu for detailed actions.
purpose: To provide a menu interface for Wizard-driven reports, allowing users (e.g., placing and receiving agents) to select, filter, and access wizard reports based on session context and actor role.

workflows.name: Displaying Wizards
steps: UserControl is loaded within ReportMenu context.
ObjectDataSource dsWizards is configured with user session and actor role parameters.
GridView displays available wizards filtered by session/role.
User selects a wizard from the gridData.
User is redirected to ReportWizardMenu.aspx with the selected WizardID in the query string.

business_rules: Wizard list is filtered based on placing/receiving user boolean flags.
Access to wizards is only granted if user session is valid.
validations: dsWizards_Selecting event cancels data selection if user session is null.
conditions: Data selection is conditional on UserSession being non-null.
Parameters PA and RA are set based on actor role.
system_behavior: Caches UserSession in RowCommand for wizard selection.
Redirects to ReportWizardMenu with WizardID after selection.
dependencies: Depends on ObjectDataSource and GridView for binding and display.
Uses QueryString utility for URL manipulation.
exceptions: If UserSession is null, data selection is cancelled and no wizards are displayed.
content_gaps: No wizard report schema or field details beyond session filtering.
